title: HR Intelligence Worker input
description: Select one bounded job type. Production jobs are dispatched by the HR backend.

conversationId.title: Stored conversation ID
conversationId.description: Required for intelligence and peer refresh jobs.

intercomId.title: Intercom conversation ID
intercomId.description: Required for intelligence and peer refresh jobs.

sourceRevision.title: Source revision
sourceRevision.description: Optional revision key used for durable deduplication.

forceReprocess.title: Force reprocess
forceReprocess.description: Create a new explicit processing attempt.

skipPeerRefresh.title: Skip peer refresh
skipPeerRefresh.description: Skip deferred peer refresh for this intelligence job.

employeeIdentityIds.title: Employee identity IDs
employeeIdentityIds.description: Bounded stored identity IDs for peer refresh.

relatedCaseSearchScope.title: Related case search scope
relatedCaseSearchScope.description: Required for peer refresh; use null for an unrestricted scope.

enqueueSiblingReprocess.title: Enqueue sibling processing
enqueueSiblingReprocess.description: Keep sibling fan-out bounded to the existing maximum of 20.

limit.title: Recovery batch size
limit.description: Maximum number of outbox rows to dispatch in one recovery run.

source.title: Sync source
source.description: Only used for the scheduled store directory sync.

executionId.title: Internal execution ID
executionId.description: Internal run tracking. Set by the backend dispatcher.
